releaseNotes: Fixes replacement transactions so failed calendar, installer, and app-update writes restore safely without retaining backups.
Adds correct weekly, monthly, yearly, cancellation, exception, time-zone, and tentative-event handling for public iCalendar feeds.
Makes source refresh actions contextual and prevents file calendars from running the Robinson network sync.
Fixes live widget countdown units, optional schedule privacy in notifications, settings health warnings, and reset confirmations.
Preserves setup, personalization, unknown settings fields, calendars, bookmarks, notifications, and user data across source changes.
